description: This file is the main React component 'App' for an e-commerce frontend. It manages state for products, categories, cart, and UI visibility; fetches initial data via API calls; and composes the main layout including product listing, filtering, cart view, and order form.

methods.name: fetchInitialData
methods.description: Fetches products and categories data in parallel and updates state.

methods.name: handleCategoryFilter
methods.description: Filters the products based on selected category or resets to all products.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a product to the shopping cart, or increases quantity if it already exists.

methods.name: updateCartQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific product in the cart, removing it if quantity is zero or less.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Removes all items from the cart.

methods.name: getTotalItems
methods.description: Calculates the total number of items in the cart.

search-terms: fetch products and categories on load
